content_en.prompt: Beaver Tina asks Lina to sort photos into 12 albums by month, in the usual (calendar) order. But since it's April Fools' Day, Lina sorts the month names alphabetically instead.
content_en.question: In which album will Tina find the pictures from June?
content_en.explanation: Sorting all 12 month names alphabetically (April, August, December, February, January, July, June, March, May, November, October, September), June lands in position 7.
content_en.ct_explanation: We often want to sort things, and computer science helps do this quickly. But before sorting, it's important to decide WHICH order is wanted — a computer doesn't inherently know; you must explicitly tell it the sorting criterion (chronological vs. alphabetical, in this case).

content_zh.prompt: 海狸Tina請Lina把照片依照月份分類，放進12本相簿，原本預期是照日曆順序排列。但因為是愚人節，Lina惡作劇改成依照月份英文名稱的字母順序來排。
content_zh.question: Tina會在第幾本相簿裡找到6月的照片？
content_zh.explanation: 把12個月份的英文名稱依字母順序排列(April、August、December、February、January、July、June、March、May、November、October、September)，June(六月)排在第7個位置。
content_zh.cs_domain: 系統性列舉、計數與推理
content_zh.ct_explanation: 我們經常需要把東西排序，資訊科學可以幫我們快速完成這件事。但排序之前，一定要先決定「要用哪種順序」——電腦本身並不會知道你要的是哪一種，你必須明確告訴它排序的依據（這裡是「時間順序」還是「字母順序」的差別）。
